device.model: HD8100 Series / SHD-8110 / SHD-8140 (System ID 0B000A00, v1.4.44 MCAS build)
device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.board: 0B000A00 (bootloader version "M3601A 1.1.3", 8 MB SPI flash, 128 MB DDR2/DDR3 M3606 / C3603 platform)
device.soc: ALi M3601A / M3606 / C3603 (chip word 0x3603, SDK sys_ic_get_chip_id=0x10047, rev=0x20001; seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200)
device.demod: internal ALi S3501 DVB-S2 (NIM_S3501_0 at I2C 0x33)

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_HD8100_Series_v1.4.44_mcas.rar from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, run_dump_hd8100_mcas_1444_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8100_mcas_1444_capture_screen.py): the "M3601A 1.1.3" bootloader prints "APP  init ok", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E9103C, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA7000200 and maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores.  The application prints "sys_ic_get_chip_id=0x10047 sys_ic_get_rev_id =0x20001", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, populates userdb(64+64) at 0x73FF80, and renders its 32-bpp ARGB8888 OSD through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (9 GE commands, 30 colours).

desc: Amiko HD8100 Series (System ID 0B000A00) firmware v1.4.44 MCAS (2012-06-08) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3601A / M3606 (C3603) Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.
Uses a dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" architecture with SEE running at 0xA7000200, an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and a 43-entry 0x44xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
